target.title: fix(xai): add handshakeTimeout to TTS and realtime voice bridge WebSockets
target.body:
AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed and understand the change.

## What Problem This Solves

Two xAI WebSocket connections — TTS stream and realtime voice bridge — create `new WebSocket()` without `handshakeTimeout`. The `ws` library defaults this to 0 (unlimited), so a stalled TCP peer during the HTTP→WebSocket upgrade hangs indefinitely. Alix-007 already added `handshakeTimeout` to Slack, Discord, Mattermost, QQBot, Reef, ClickClack, Browser CDP, and Signal receiver; these two xAI sockets were missed.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **TTS stream** (`tts.ts`): `handshakeTimeout: timeoutMs` (30 s default)
- **Realtime voice bridge** (`realtime-voice-bridge.ts`): `handshakeTimeout: XAI_REALTIME_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 s)

The parameter passes directly to `new WebSocket(url, { handshakeTimeout: N })`.

## User Impact

Stalled xAI connections now fail within their timeout instead of hanging indefinitely. Healthy connections are unaffected.

## Evidence

### Before vs After (controlled stalled WebSocket upgrade)

A TCP server accepts but stalls the upgrade (partial HTTP 101, no terminating `\r\n`). The `ws` library — the same library every changed OpenClaw file delegates to — is exercised with real TCP:

```json
{"label":"BEFORE (default=0, unlimited)","handshakeTimeoutMs":0,"outcome":"REJECTED","error":"aborted after 5000ms","elapsed_ms":5016}
{"label":"AFTER xAI TTS (5 s)","handshakeTimeoutMs":5000,"outcome":"REJECTED","error":"Opening handshake has timed out","elapsed_ms":5015}
{"label":"AFTER xAI bridge (10 s)","handshakeTimeoutMs":10000,"outcome":"REJECTED","error":"Opening handshake has timed out","elapsed_ms":10015}
```

- **BEFORE**: `handshakeTimeout=0` → still hanging at 5 s (aborted externally). This IS the pre-fix behavior — ws waits forever.
- **AFTER** (5 s): `"Opening handshake has timed out"` at 5015 ms — terminated within deadline.
- **AFTER** (10 s): `"Opening handshake has timed out"` at 10015 ms — configurable, matches production value.

### Focused tests (parameter plumbing verified)

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/tts.test.ts --run
Test Files  1 passed (1)  Tests  26 passed (26)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/realtime-voice-provider.test.ts --run
Test Files  1 passed (1)  Tests  36 passed (36)
```

- `expect(ws?.handshakeTimeout).toBe(5_000)` — timeoutMs reaches ws constructor.
- `expect(options).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ handshakeTimeout: 10_000 }))` — constant reaches ws constructor.
